name: Ralph Winmill
story: Ralph Winmill is named as an author of “New Zealand Land Tenure Beyond 2000: Full Integration and Automation of the New Zealand Survey and Title Systems” in the proceedings of GeoComputation and SIRC at the University of Otago, 26–29 August 1997.
